claims: The D03 drift resampler, built for soft-float big-endian MIPS32r2 (mips-unknown-linux-musl) and run as PID 1, produced the f32 samples of the host quality tones; they meet the bands declared in docs/contracts/d03.md section 4.1 before any Rust ran, agree with the double-precision reference, and are byte-identical to the host build of the same source.
Guest instructions per output frame of DriftResampler::render, read from the CP0 Count through a ruler calibrated in the same boot.
A per-run seed (SplitMix64 phase) ties two extra cases to this boot; a replayed transcript and a truncated dump each fail the judge.

commands.boot_and_judge_with_replay_plant: FFW_BUILD_DIR=<kernel cache> python3 toolchain/src/measure-d03-target.py run --elf <elf> --log-dir <fresh dir> --host-log <host log> --revision 9282ba6 --plant replay
commands.boot_and_judge_with_truncate_plant: FFW_BUILD_DIR=<kernel cache> python3 toolchain/src/measure-d03-target.py run --elf <elf> --log-dir <fresh dir> --host-log <host log> --revision 9282ba6 --plant truncate
commands.note: The seeds are in each run entry. The ELF is not committed (its sha256 is above): rebuild it from the recorded sources, or supply the same bytes. The plant-replay transcript is judged under its own seed; plant-truncate under run 2's.

elf.build_command: cd <snapshot> && RCH_CANONICAL_PROJECT_ROOT=<snapshot> RCH_REQUIRE_REMOTE=1 RCH_WORKER=<worker set> CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<snapshot>/build/d03-target-target rch exec -- cargo +nightly build --offline --release --manifest-path toolchain/src/d03-target/Cargo.toml --target mips-unknown-linux-musl -Z build-std=core,alloc,std,panic_abort --config 'target.mips-unknown-linux-musl.linker="<snapshot>/toolchain/linker/zig-cc-mips-be"' --config 'target.mips-unknown-linux-musl.rustflags=["-C","target-feature=+crt-static","-C","link-self-contained=no"]' -j 2
elf.build_result: Finished `release` profile, remote worker <worker>, exit 0 (supervisor lane, build b25)
elf.name: ffw-d03-target
elf.snapshot: git archive of the repository head above plus the three files; the snapshot's Cargo.lock is the repository's
elf.toolchain: worker nightly toolchain; its library sources are version 1.99.0; `rustc -vV` was not captured for this build

evidence_class: host simulation: QEMU TCG with -icount, a 24Kf MIPS model. Not hardware.

host_digests.log_not_committed: the full log carries worker names and local paths; only its four D03-TARGET-HOST records are kept
host_digests.source: cargo test -p franken-dsp --locked -- --nocapture (test d03_target_canonical_samples_are_well_formed_and_digested), central run on repository head 9282ba6, exit 0

judge.mutation_checks: 14 of 14 deliberate breakages of a judge check are caught by the named test (scratch-copy sweep, run before the boots)
judge.self_test_result: 45 tests, unittest rc 0, run 2026-11-05 after the boots

not_covered: Cycles on a real core: QEMU icount counts executed instructions only; no cache, pipeline, memory-latency or multiplier timing.
A board clock: the repository records none for any MIPS board, so no percentage of a CPU is claimed.
The real DAC path, programme material, stereo cross-talk, quality during a slew, clipping.
A nominal-ratio figure is not the worst case: at exactly 0 ppb the fractional position is zero and soft-float zero fast paths apply.
The ruler's fitted intercept was negative (about -1270 ticks in run 1, -697 in run 2); the residual and drift gates held and the cause is not explained.
D03 is not closed by this receipt: it is blocked by D01 (which is blocked by P01, then E06).

qemu.command: qemu-system-mips -M malta -cpu 24Kf -m 64M -nographic -no-reboot -icount shift=0,align=off,sleep=off -kernel <kernel> -initrd <initramfs> -append "console=ttyS0,38400 rdinit=/init panic=-1 loglevel=3"
qemu.initramfs: toolchain/src/mkinitramfs.py: the ELF as /init plus the per-run seed as /ffw_seed (plant-replay also /plant-replay and /replay); sha256 of mkinitramfs.py in judge section
